Nose Surgery in Barcelona

Rinoplastia ultrasonica en Barcelona

The Nose Surgery in Barcelona is the treatment to improve the forma, el tamaño and the apariencia general de la nariz. El objetivo de la nose surgery in Barcelona es conseguir un aspecto natural que ofrezca un aspecto equilibrado con el resto de la cara. La nose job in Barcelona can reduce or increase the size of your nose, change the shape of the tip or the bridge of the nose, improve the opening of the nostrils, or change the angle between the nose and the upper lip or forehead.

It can also correct a birth defect or help improve breathing problems. The surgery is performed bajo anestesia general con ingreso ambulatorio normalmente, post-surgery recovery takes between 7 and 10 days, although the final result of the surgery will not be seen until a few months later.

The Best Rhinoplasty Surgeons in Barcelona

The nose is a central feature of anyone's face and is also an essential part of the body for proper breathing. nose surgery in Barcelona es un procedimiento quirúrgico con el que se busca cambiar o mejorar la apariencia de la nariz.

At Clínica Belba we have plastic surgeons who are experts in rinoplastia ultrasonica en Barcelona, who can treat problems and conditions that reduce the patient's quality of life and self-esteem. We invite everyone interested to consult us about this procedure.

What is nasal plastic surgery?

Nose remodelling surgery is a plastic surgery procedure that can reconfigure, reshape and repair the structure and shape of the nose. For this reason, the operation can address skin, cartilage and the bone of the septum.

El propósito de la Ultrasonic rhinoplasty in Barcelona can be functional, that is, to correct injuries or congenital abnormalities. It can also be aesthetic, to reduce the size, lift the nose, lift the skin, change the proportions and improve the appearance of the tip of the nose.

If the patient needs it, the surgeon will make the nose look more harmonious and better suited to the face and allow the patient to breathe better, all in a single operation.

When is nasal plastic surgery recommended?

Si quieres hacerte una nose remodelling surgery in Barcelona, you should know that this procedure is recommended whenever the person has reached full development and has the approval of the plastic surgeon.

Son buenos candidatos quienes necesiten cambiar el tamaño, el puente nasal o buscan un levantamiento de la nariz. Asimismo, para reducir las fosas o corregir el ángulo de un tabique desviado.

Expected results of a nose job in Barcelona

When the nose lift has been performed to improve breathing and put an end to allergy problems or obstruction of the nasal passages, the results in the patient's quality of life are very noticeable and begin to be perceived once the postoperative period has ended. 

The aesthetic results are very evident, even on leaving the operating theatre. Rhinoplasty is a plastic surgery procedure with permanent results. 

¿Cuánto vale una rinoplastia en Barcelona? The cost varies depending on the surgeon, the complexity of the case and the facilities of the clinic. It is essential to consult accredited professionals to obtain an accurate assessment and understand the cost of the procedure.

Risks of nasal plastic surgery

Los riesgos de una operación de rinoplastia en Barcelona are related to the effects of anaesthesia. Some patients may experience an adverse reaction and difficulty breathing. Other risks include the development of infections, bleeding and oedema.

Además, la rhinoplasty podría provocar pérdida de tabique o deformaciones no deseadas del contorno y afectar la respiración, lo que llevaría a una segunda operación.

Clinica rinoplastia Barcelona

Make an appointment

Preoperative stage of nose remodelling surgery

During the preoperative stage of this facial plastic surgery, the patient must commit to following all the guidelines of their medical team and act prudently to maintain the health conditions necessary for the day of the operation. 

Consultation before nasal plastic surgery

The first consultation between surgeon and patient is the ideal opportunity to discuss expectations and explain what the physical and functional change of the nose would be. We recommend raising all your questions at this meeting and going through the nasal plastic surgery in detail so that the person can feel confident and secure. 

At Clínica Belba, the surgeons use the first consultation to show digital images of the possible changes for the best ultrasonic rhinoplasty in Barcelona, and to draw up a personalised treatment plan.

Preoperative instructions for nose plastic surgery in Barcelona

There are instructions and advice that the patient must follow to reduce risks and avoid complications. How long this period lasts will depend on the patient's health, their schedule for arranging the operation and having the time required for recovery. 

Before the operation, you must not drink alcohol, smoke tobacco or take contraindicated medication. Instead, patients are encouraged to eat well and to have regular tests and check-ups. 

Nose remodelling surgery procedure

The complete procedure for nasal remodelling consists of planning the different stages the patient will go through. The plastic surgeon specialising in otorhinolaryngology will coordinate all the details together with the patient. 

Technique used in nose surgery in Barcelona

The surgeon may choose between a closed rhinoplasty technique, using an endoscopic or frontal light method. The other alternative could be open nasal surgery for a deeper reconstruction of the tissues and the septum. 

Anestesia empleada

Toda rinoplastia en Barcelona se hace con el paciente bajo anestesia general, administrada por un anestesiólogo calificado, asegurando la viabilidad de la intervención quirúrgica. 

Intervention duration 

The nose surgery in Barcelona no suele superar las dos horas, a menos que en el procedimiento sea necesaria una reconstrucción compleja.

Postoperative period after nasal plastic surgery

On leaving the operating theatre after facial plastic surgery, the postoperative period, or the patient's recovery process, begins. Caution, rest and hygiene are essential for a successful recovery. 

Recovery time after nose remodelling surgery

The patient can resume most of their daily, work and physical activities in four to six weeks. However, they must be careful with any actions that could expose them to trauma. 

Care after nasal plastic surgery

After nasal surgery the face and nose will be swollen, and bruising may also be noticeable on the face. Nasal congestion in the first few days is normal, and there will be discomfort from the operation and from the splint the surgeon will fit for the first few days. 

For at least one week, the patient must take antibiotics and take painkillers when they feel pain and to reduce swelling. 

While washing, the dressings must not get wet and, if there are incisions, they must be kept clean and dry. For the first few days, to avoid bleeding, you should sleep sitting up. Other precautions are not to blow your nose and to limit facial expressions. We advise brushing your teeth gently. 

The best rhinoplasty surgeons in Barcelona

Clínica Belba is one of the plastic surgery centres most recognised for the quality of the service we provide, our years of experience and the certified team that leads the cutting-edge treatments we carry out. 

Best rhinoplasty surgeon in Barcelona

Our team of doctors includes Dr. Mike Dewever and Dr. Félix Chavarría, two plastic surgeons with extensive experience in aesthetic procedures such as rinoplastia ultrasonica en Barcelona. Agenda tu cita ya con nosotros. 

Frequently Asked Questions:

What is the price of rhinoplasty in Barcelona?

The Rhinoplasty costs They are provided in a quote that the patient can review carefully. Likewise, our administrative staff is available to clarify any doubts.

Ultrasonic rhinoplasty price Barcelona

Rhinoplasty prices Barcelona

What scars does a nose job leave?

Closed rhinoplasty does not involve incisions, and therefore, does not leave any scars. Open rhinoplasty leaves a very small mark under the nose.

Nose surgery Barcelona

When is nose surgery in Barcelona contraindicated?

Rhinoplasty or nose surgery in Barcelona is contraindicated for people with diabetes, obesity, immunosuppression, heart problems and hypertension.

What is a good time for nasal plastic surgery?

Any time can be the right time for a rhinoplasty, provided you have the surgeon's approval and the patient is in good health.

rinoplastia ultrasonica Barcelona

How painful is a nose job in Barcelona?

Rhinoplasty is not painful, although you may experience some discomfort during the first few days after surgery. People may feel pain in the nose and head, as well as swelling and bruising.

How long does the pain last after a rhinoplasty in Barcelona?

After a rhinoplasty, it is normal to experience mild to moderate pain in the nose and head. This pain generally varies in intensity and usually lasts between 36 and 72 hours. The nose may remain sore or sensitive to touch for up to three months after the procedure.

It is also normal to feel nasal congestion and have trouble breathing for a short period of time. Discomfort and pain should begin to subside within 72 hours after surgery.

operacion nariz Barcelona

Is sensation lost after nose remodelling surgery?

Two things can happen: heightened sensitivity at the tip of the nose or at the edges of the nostrils, or a loss of sensation. In both cases, it is a temporary reaction.

How many times can a rhinoplasty be performed in Barcelona?

There is no set limit on the number of rhinoplasties that can be performed on a person. In theory, it is possible to undergo nose surgery as many times as is necessary and safe for the patient.

However, it is important to bear in mind that each additional surgery in the same area can increase the risk of complications and unsatisfactory results. Patients are advised to wait at least 9 to 12 months after a rhinoplasty before considering another.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuándo se contraindica una cirugía nariz Barcelona?

acceptedAnswer.text: La rinoplastia o Cirugia nariz Barcelona está contraindicada para personas diabéticas, con obesidad, inmunosupresión y problemas cardíacos e hipertensión.

mainEntity.name: ¿Qué momento es bueno para una cirugía plástica nasal?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Cualquier momento puede ser el adecuado para una rinoplastia, siempre que se cuente con la autorización del cirujano y el paciente tenga un buen estado de salud.

rinoplastia ultrasonica Barcelona

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuán dolorosa resulta una operación de nariz en Barcelona?

acceptedAnswer.text: La rinoplastia no es dolorosa, aunque es posible que se experimenten ciertas molestias durante los primeros días después de la cirugía. Las personas pueden sentir dolor en la zona de la nariz y la cabeza, así como hinchazón y moretones.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuánto tiempo dura el dolor luego de una rinoplastia en Barcelona?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Después de una rinoplastia, es normal experimentar dolor leve a moderado en la zona de la nariz y la cabeza. Por lo general, este dolor varía en intensidad y suele durar entre 36 y 72 horas. Es posible que la nariz permanezca dolorida o sensible al tacto hasta tres meses después del procedimiento.

También es normal sentir congestión nasal y problemas para respirar durante un breve período de tiempo. La incomodidad y el dolor deben comenzar a disminuir dentro de las 72 horas después de la cirugía.

operacion nariz Barcelona

mainEntity.name: ¿Se pierde la sensibilidad luego de la operación de remodelado de la nariz?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pueden ocurrir dos cosas, tener una alta sensibilidad en la punta de la nariz o a los extremos de las fosas nasales y una pérdida de sensibilidad. En ambos casos, se trata de una reacción temporal.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuántas veces se puede hacer una rinoplastia Bcn?

acceptedAnswer.text:
No hay un límite establecido en cuanto al número de rinoplastia Bcn que se pueden realizar en una persona. En teoría, es posible someterse a la cirugía de nariz tantas veces como sea necesario y seguro para el paciente.

Sin embargo, es importante tener en cuenta que cada cirugía adicional en la misma área puede aumentar el riesgo de complicaciones y resultados insatisfactorios. Se recomienda que los pacientes esperen al menos 9 a 12 meses después de una rinoplastia antes de considerar otra.
